nderwater icon — This icon represents sites that are submerged. There are no additional rules for such sites, although some cards have game text that affects underwater sites.

lown away Blockade Flagship — The starfighter Bravo Fighter details how to blow away the Neimoidian Blockade Flagship. If blown away, the Blockade Flagship and any Flagship locations on table are placed out of play (and may not be re-deployed this game). Any cards on the Flagship (or at a Flagship site) are placed in their owner’s Lost Pile.

arth Sidious, Senator Palpatine & Emperor Palpatine — Darth Sidious, Senator Palpatine, and Emperor Palpatine are three distinct personas. They are unrelated to each other for all game play purposes. Game text will refer to these three personas as Sidious, Palpatine, and Emperor respectively.

aboo location deployment — For the layout of Naboo locations, please refer to rule card 3A of the Coruscant expansion set. This can also be viewed online at www.decipher.com/starwars/rules.
